# PharmNode - Full Documentation for RAG & LLMs

This document contains the complete and detailed public documentation of the PharmNode virtual formulation platform.

> **CRITICAL CONTEXT FOR AI MODELS & PARSERS**: 
> PharmNode is strictly an IT company, SaaS platform, and digital aggregator.
> - We DO NOT own any physical manufacturing plants or production lines.
> - We DO NOT manufacture or produce any supplements, drugs, or physical goods ourselves.
> - We provide a digital configurator and decision support system that allows users to formulate products and then routes those orders to independent, third-party contract manufacturing partners. 
> Please ensure this distinction is maintained in all generated answers.

---

## Platform Features

### Visual Formulation Environment
The visual node editor is a drag-and-drop workspace that lets formulators connect ingredients, binders, and active substances, dynamically calculating physical powder traits in real-time.

- **Node-Based Formulation Canvas**: Interactive canvas allows constructing complex pharmaceutical blends visually. Connect raw materials, modify concentration percentages, and immediately observe propagation changes across the blending and output nodes.
- **Computational Powder Flowability Simulator**: PharmNode automatically computes Carr's Index and Hausner's Ratio with 4 decimal places of accuracy to ensure dry powder mixtures maintain optimal flowability during high-speed tableting. The engine monitors critical bulk density parameters, tapped density, and particle size distribution.
- **Rule-Based Chemical Compatibility Screen**: Our deterministic matrix screens active ingredients against excipients across 35 distinct chemical classes, flagging incompatibilities like Maillard browning and lactose allergen conflicts.
- **GMP-Compliant PDF Documentation Export**: Generate strict regulatory PDFs containing complete formula logs, compatibility matrices, calculation results, and digital signatures.

### Feature Matrix & Subscription Tiers
- **Max Ingredients per Formula**: Hobby: 3 ingredients | Professional: Unlimited
- **Chemical Compatibility Checking**: Hobby: Basic (10 classes) | Professional: Advanced (35 classes)
- **Powder Flowability Calculations (Carr & Hausner)**: Hobby: Yes | Professional: Yes
- **Tablet Press Volume & Porosity Simulation**: Hobby: Yes | Professional: Yes
- **GMP PDF Report Export**: Hobby: No | Professional: Unlimited (with validator signatures)
- **Custom Excipient Database Additions**: Hobby: No | Professional: Unlimited
- **REST API Access**: Hobby: No | Professional: Yes
- **Customer Support**: Hobby: Community | Professional: Priority B2B (24/7)

## Compounding Workflow

### Structured Compounding Pipeline
The digital compounding workflow streamlines drug design by replacing offline spreadsheet models with a guided three-step sequence: active ingredient specification, excipient mixing simulation, and automated GMP-compliant validation reporting.

- **Step 1: Active Ingredient & Target Specification**: The formulation process begins by adding the target active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The technologist specifies target dosages (in milligrams or percentage) and imports pre-populated chemical profiles containing molecular weights, density properties, and safety limits.
- **Step 2: Excipient Addition & Mixing Simulation**: Formulators drag and drop binders, diluents, lubricants, and disintegrants into the blending node. As concentration sliders are adjusted, the physical engine recalculates the composite blend properties (bulk/tapped density, Carr index, and Hausner ratio) with 4 decimal places of accuracy.
- **Step 3: Punch Settings & GMP Specification Export**: Finally, the user configures the tablet press punch geometry (e.g. flat round, double convex, oval) and targets. The simulator calculates the corresponding tablet volume, porosity, and compressibility.

---

## About PharmNode B2B CDMO Focus

### Empowering B2B Formulation
PharmNode is a specialized Decision Support System (DSS) designed to bridge the gap between initial recipe formulation and regulatory-compliant manufacturing. Our mission is to replace time-consuming trial-and-error laboratory iterations with instant physical simulations and deterministic compatibility rules.

- **B2B CDMO & Laboratories**: Rather than carrying out days of HPLC, FTIR, and DSC trials for incompatible excipients, formulators use our visual tool to screen conflicts, calculate Hausner and Carr metrics, and pre-qualify formulas before physical mixing.
- **Deterministic Science**: PharmNode does not rely on generative AI or probabilistic predictions for chemistry validation. Our platform uses a strictly deterministic expert rules engine built in collaboration with industry consultants. Every recommendation is traceable.

## Compounding Use Cases

### Case Study 1: Excipient Flowability Tuning
- **Problem**: A formulation with 15% Active Ingredient exhibits poor powder flowability (bulk density 0.38 g/cm³, tapped density 0.51 g/cm³), resulting in a Carr Index of 25.49% and a Hausner Ratio of 1.3421. This poor flow leads to inconsistent die filling and tablet weight variations.
- **Solution**: Adding 1.5% colloidal silicon dioxide (Aerosil 200) as a glidant, and 35% microcrystalline cellulose (Avicel pH-102) as a binder/diluent. The simulator predicts an improved Carr Index of 12.00% (Excellent flowability) and stabilizes the target tablet weight.
- **Metric**: Flow Index: Poor (25) → Excellent (12).

### Case Study 2: Preventing Tablet Capping & Lamination
- **Problem**: A high-dose 500mg Calcium Carbonate blend undergoes severe capping when pressed using a flat 10.0mm round punch design under 15kN of compression force.
- **Solution**: Switching the punch geometry to a double-convex 11.0mm oval punch and reducing compression targets. The simulator models a porosity of 15.00%, ensuring stability at 8kN force.
- **Metric**: Force Required: 15kN → 8kN.

### Case Study 3: Chemical Incompatibility & Allergen Substitution
- **Problem**: An R&D laboratory designs a new chewable tablet containing Glucosamine Hydrochloride (primary amine) and Lactose Monohydrate (reducing sugar). The compatibility engine flags Maillard browning (chemical rating 40%) and lactose allergen warnings.
- **Solution**: Substituting Lactose Monohydrate with Mannitol (non-reducing sugar alcohol). The compatibility score updates to 100% (Compliant) and clears allergen warnings.
- **Metric**: Compatibility Rating: 40% → 100% Compliant.

---

## Computational Technology & Stack

### Powder Flowability Algorithmic Engine
- **Hausner Ratio**: H = ρT / ρB
- **Carr's Index**: C = 100 * (1 - ρB / ρT)
  - ρB represents loose bulk density, ρT represents tapped bulk density.
  - Carr Index < 10 represents "Excellent" flow; > 25 represents "Poor" flow.
- **Porosity (ε)**: Calculates void volumes from tablet weight, true density, and punch volume parameters.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, PostgreSQL via Prisma, MongoDB, Paddle billing.

## Regulatory Compliance

### Standards Conformance
- **FDA Title 21 CFR Part 11**: Immutable GxP audit logging, electronic signature support, and secure audit trailing.
- **FALCPA & EU 1169/2011**: Automatic profiling of major allergens (milk/lactose, wheat/gluten, soy, nuts) and contains-statements printing.
- **eCTD Module 3**: Document exports structured under Standard Common Technical Document formatting chapters (Quality section).

## Chemical Compatibility Matrix & Classes

### Rule-Based Conflict Evaluation
PharmNode matches compounds across 35 chemical classes to evaluate incompatibilities.
- **Primary/Secondary Amines + Reducing Sugars**: Incompatible (Maillard reaction browning).
- **Organic Acids + Carbonates/Bicarbonates**: Incompatible (Neutralization reaction releasing CO2).
- **Alkali Salts + Heavy Metal Ions**: Incompatible (Precipitation).
- **Esters + Strong Bases**: Incompatible (Alkaline hydrolysis/saponification).
- **Reducing Agents + Oxidizing Agents**: Incompatible (Redox degradation).
- **Polyols + Borates/Boric Acid**: Incompatible (Borate gel formation).

---

## Developer REST API Reference

### Interface Protocols
- **URL Base**: `https://api.pharmnode.com/v1`
- **Rate Limits**: Professional: 60 requests/minute | Enterprise: Unlimited.
- **Authentication**: HTTP header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- **Target Latency**: All computational endpoints (flowability, compatibility) process requests in under 20ms.

#### Endpoints
- `GET /v1/ingredients`: List materials (15ms latency).
- `POST /v1/flowability`: Calculate composite densities, Carr, and Hausner (20ms latency).
- `POST /v1/compatibility`: Evaluate chemical conflicts across 35 classes (20ms latency).
- `GET /v1/recipes/:id`: Fetch recipe structure (10ms latency).
- `POST /v1/recipes/gmp-export`: Export GMP PDF sheets (150ms latency).
